$sources: The species: Ranunculus acris L., meadow buttercup: a perennial to 1 m, the basal leaves palmately 3-7-lobed; flowers 1.5-2.5 cm, the five petals glossy yellow, cupped; flowering May to August (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Ranunculaceae).
The plants at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built meadow, HallOfLightPlanting.swift and nature.py:922-930), heights 0.4-0.9.
name: Ranunculus acris
note: Yellow, as the sheet colours it (0xE6C77A); in full flower in June. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
